1.title: Overview
1.content:
Cube Shooter is a fast-paced survival game where your goal is to last as long as possible against endless waves of enemies.

Enemies spawn in increasingly larger numbers and with tougher stats as waves progress. To keep up, you’ll need to use your ammo wisely, collect powerups that drop in battle, and upgrade your abilities after every few waves.

The core loop is simple but challenging: Survive → Score → Upgrade → Repeat. The further you go, the more intense it becomes.

2.title: Controls
2.content:
The game automatically detects your input device.

Keyboard & Mouse:
• Move — W, A, S, D
• Aim — Mouse Cursor
• Shoot — Left Click
• Reload — R
• Sprint — Hold Shift

Controller (Gamepad):
• Move — Left Stick
• Aim — Right Stick
• Shoot — R2 / RT
• Sprint — L2 / LT or L3
• Reload — X (Xbox) / Square (PS)

Mobile:
• Left Stick — Move
• Right Stick — Aim & Shoot
• Drag screen to look around (if not using sticks)

3.title: Powerups
3.content:
Powerups are temporary bonuses that can turn the tide of battle. They drop randomly from defeated enemies and vanish after a short time if not picked up.

Available powerups:
• HP Recovery — Restores part of your health bar.
• Double Damage — Doubles bullet damage for a short duration.
• Ammo Resupply — Instantly adds reserve ammo.
• Max Ammo — Instantly fills your magazine completely.
• Triple Shot — Fires three bullets in a spread instead of one.
• Immunity — Grants temporary invincibility against all damage.

Pro Tip: Don’t hoard powerups — grab them when you need them most, especially Immunity before a tough wave.

4.title: Upgrades
4.content:
Every 3 waves, you will enter the upgrade screen where you can choose permanent improvements for your character. These upgrades stack over time, letting you customize your playstyle.

Upgrade categories:
• Damage — Increases bullet damage.
• Health — Boosts your max HP and slightly heals you.
• Speed — Improves both walking and sprinting speed.
• Magazine — Expands your ammo capacity before needing to reload.
• Crit Chance — Increases the likelihood of dealing extra damage.
• Crit Damage — Increases the damage multiplier for critical hits.

Strategy Tip: Don’t always pick damage first. Sometimes more health or speed is the difference between survival and defeat.

5.title: Enemies
5.content:
The game features diverse enemy types with unique behaviors:

• Basic/Normal — Balanced stats, dangerous in swarms.
• Fast — Low health but rushes you down quickly.
• Tank — High health, slow, absorbs lots of damage.
• Spitter — Fires red projectiles from a distance.
• Summoner — Retreats and spawns Minions to overwhelm you.
• Thrower — Hurls rocks that deal damage on impact.
• Sniper — Tracks you with a laser before firing a high-damage shot. Dodge when the laser stops moving!
• Linker — Connects to nearby enemies and heals them.
• Juggernaut — Massive, heavily armored unit that charges at you if you get too far.
• Giant — A massive boss-like variant with huge health.

Hint: Kill Healers (Linkers) and Summoners first!

6.title: Tips
6.content:
• Keep moving — Staying still makes you an easy target.
• Manage your ammo — Reload between waves or after clearing space.
• Use powerups wisely — Don’t waste Immunity when only a few enemies are alive.
• Prioritize threats — Take out fast enemies and Snipers first.
• Upgrade with balance — Mix offense and defense to avoid being glass-cannon fragile.
• Learn the map — Use space to kite enemies instead of letting them box you in.

Remember: The key to high scores is survival. The longer you last, the more dangerous (and rewarding) each wave becomes.
